current.text: Klay Thompson signed with Miami in the offseason.
He is projected to start at guard next to Mitchell, Wiggins, Giannis and Bam. The expert gives that lineup about a 75% chance.
Even as a starter, he may play only about 20 minutes and may not close games. The start may be partly ceremonial.
The expert calls his ADP of 109 crazy and would not draft him inside the top 300.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.
With the March 28 end, Miami plays 4-3-3 in our playoff weeks, 10 games in total. The expert calls that a weak playoff schedule.
Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: He is 36 and has torn both the ACL and the Achilles in the same leg.
He can still shoot, but he no longer moves or defends as he used to.
He is a threes-only fantasy contributor. He adds little in other categories.
His steals are far below the league pool, at about 0.4 to 0.5 per game.
